measurement_scope: discovery capture to report; includes setup/testing, not per-skill conversion time

skills.name: algorithmic-art
skills.usefulness: Seeded generative art with reproducible settings and interactive exploration.
skills.audience: Creative coders, generative artists, and coding educators.
skills.impact: Potentially improves repeatable experiments and teaches simulation controls.
skills.impact_evidence: Expected benefit only; no adoption or time savings measured.
skills.changes: Staged at an immutable revision; rewrote Codex instructions, removed mandatory branding/remote fonts, added a load-failure message and verification criteria. Preserved source/license.
skills.validation: Registry and authoring checks passed. Tooling/report suite: 40 passed, 2 platform skips. Scoped search: 33 owned repos and zero indexed name matches.
skills.limitations: No real artwork workflow, browser acceptance, dependency security review, fresh installation, or final review yet. Not release-ready.
skills.learning: Deterministic seeds need fixed frame/size/version. A CDN dependency is not offline self-contained.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.usefulness: Distinctive visual design for websites and UI.
skills.impact: May refine aesthetics; this project's value is avoiding overlapping migration work.
skills.impact_evidence: Overlap assessment; no measured productivity result.
skills.changes: Inventoried and assessed; rejected due to material overlap with installed Sites UI/site-design capability.
skills.validation: Read real instructions and compared installed workflow. No migration claimed.
skills.limitations: Rejection is specific to this environment and strict overlap rule, not a judgment on upstream quality.
skills.learning: Compare triggers, workflow, outputs, and dependencies before choosing by stars.

next_step: Exercise algorithmic-art on a real request, capture browser/failure evidence, resolve dependencies and installation, then pass release gates for one local package.
